description_en: Queries the history of batch requests for member quotas submitted using a quota template
description_zh: 查询配额模板批量申请成员配额的申请历史
kebab_example: aliyun quotas list-quota-applications-for-template --product-code ecs-spec --quota-action-code ecs.g5.2xlarge --batch-quota-application-id d314d6ae-867d-484c-9009-3d421a800000 --quota-category CommonQuota --next-token 4 --max-results 30 --apply-start-time 2023-05-22T16:00:00Z --apply-end-time 2023-05-22T16:00:00Z --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListQuotaApplicationsForTemplate

parameters.description_en:

parameters.description_en:
The beginning of the time range to query. The value is in UTC.

> The interval between `ApplyStartTime` and `ApplyEndTime` must be 7 days or less. If you do not set these two parameters, quota applications submitted within the last 7 days are queried.
parameters.description_zh:
配额申请开始的UTC时间。

> `ApplyStartTime`和`ApplyEndTime`之间的时间间隔必须小于等于7天。如果未设置这两个参数，则配额申请时间为最近7天。
